annotations.title: Read one block of an extraction job's datasheet

description: One parsed block whole: type, page, box, text and markdown (each up to 20000 characters), heading, caption, links, its section and heading path, table cells with their boxes (up to 2000) or a drawing's crop box and the exact words inside it with their boxes (up to 400), and how many cross-references it prints or receives. Deterministic: reads the job's stored parse (parsed_document_v1), calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key; readable jobs are your own, your workspace's TEAM-shared jobs and PUBLIC jobs, as on the REST API. Refusals: NOT_PARSED / PARSE_FAILED (no usable parse stored for this job), PARSE_EXPIRED (past retention), DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE (over 20,000 blocks). Every block, cell and word comes with its page, box ([x0, y0, x1, y1] in PDF points, origin top-left), quoted text and parse {document_sha256, parser_version, block_id, cell_id}; block ids are stable only within one parser_version.

block_id.description: A block id from another of these tools (e.g. 'p36-b4-1a2b3c'); stable within one parser_version.

job_id.description: An extraction job in your account (or shared with it).
